post.summary: Ensure the caller's personal tenant exists and is complete
post.description: Creates the caller's personal tenant on first call and reads it back afterwards, completing its owner role and binding and converging the role's grants to the host's allowlist on every call. A membership row that exists is left as it stands, and a tenant that is not enabled is refused without a write. The tenant identifier and alias are derived from the account identifier; the answer names the tenant and whether this call created it.

200.description: The personal tenant, complete; created says whether this call registered it

403.description: The caller is impersonating, is a service account, or is a static-table subject that cannot own a tenant

409.description: The caller cannot have a personal tenant: it belongs to another tenant while holding none of its own (already-member), its personal tenant exists and is not enabled (tenant-unavailable), or the derived identifier or alias is unavailable (identifier-unavailable); the type field names which, and a retry does not change any of them

503.description: A dependency could not answer; no part of the result is returned

created.description: Whether this call registered the tenant

alias.description: The request-surface name, equal to the identifier for a personal tenant

kind.description: The tenant kind; the frontend renders the personal label from it
